teaser: The clatter of a departure board flipping over, letters and platforms reshuffling before anyone reads them twice — that is the kind of room you fill well. You are a 5, restless by number, and an INTP, built to turn an idea over before anyone else has finished the first version of it. The 5 wants motion and the next angle; the INTP wants the puzzle solved cleanly, for its own sake, not for an audience. Crossed, what shows up is someone who changes direction constantly, but almost always for a reason that satisfies you first, and only sometimes satisfies whoever is watching.
